use default

inventory() -> Pipe[int] is
    let counts = MAP()

    while true do
        let value mut = 0

        while true do
            let seen mut = 0
            counts.try_get_value(value, seen ref)

            yield seen

            let of_that_count mut = 0
            counts.try_get_value(seen, of_that_count ref)
            counts[seen] = of_that_count + 1

            if seen == 0 then
                break
            fi

            value = value + 1
        od
    od

use default

inventory() -> Pipe[int] is
    let counts = MAP()

    while true do
        let value mut = 0

        while true do
            let seen mut = 0
            counts.try_get_value(value, seen ref)

            yield seen

            let of_that_count mut = 0
            counts.try_get_value(seen, of_that_count ref)
            counts[seen] = of_that_count + 1

            if seen == 0 then
                break
            fi

            value = value + 1
        od
    od
si

first_at_least(threshold: int) -> INDEXED_VALUE[int] =>
    inventory()
        |> index()
        |> find_or_throw(entry => entry.value >= threshold)

inventory()
    |> take(100)
    |> chunk(10)
    |> each(row =>
        write_line(row |> map((n: int) => "{n,5}") |> join("")))

write_line("")

(1::10)
    |> each((n: int) =>
        (let threshold = n * 1000
         let found = first_at_least(threshold)
         write_line("first at least {threshold,6}: {found.value,6}"
